status: Q1/Q3 upheld, Q2/Q4 falsified — learner line closed
command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 scripts/pinball-edge-prereg.py (host numpy; venv stays stdlib-only)
finding: a learned arm can be made one-sidedly safe by changing the loss, but not both safe and accurate at this data scale: MSE spends the conservative tail, pinball spends the honest estimate (median error 0.62-0.80, 2-3 steps, i.e. claiming vision it does not have). Its shuffled control lands 0.12 below the deterministic baseline, so a third of the apparent gain is the loss's global bias, not learning. The deterministic inner bound (0.53 pessimism, 0.18 median error) remains the best self-model.
consequence: learner line closed after two attempts with two different failures; revisiting would need a per-sample control matched on prediction variance to separate bias from skill
